title: From degreewise affine-limit exchange to derived exchange
statement: Let k be a field, D:I -> Over(Spec k) a small cofiltered diagram with qcqs structure maps and affine transitions, c a cone with underlying scheme limit and qcqs structure map, and f:X -> Spec k qcqs. For any abelian etale F on X, assume the canonical bounded-below derived exchange at F[0] is invertible at every D_i. Then the exact total derived inverse image along c.pt.hom of Rf_*(F[0]) is isomorphic to the total derived direct image of (p^*F)[0] on the limit pullback [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image].

source.place: Lemma 59.86.3, second assertion, with the formal derived-category argument

proof.text: In every nonnegative degree, apply degreewise inverse-limit continuity to the homology maps of the stage derived exchanges; functors preserve their invertibility.

In negative degrees the source is zero because right derived direct image is left t-exact and exact inverse image commutes with homology. The inverse image of F[0] remains ≥0, so left t-exactness also makes the target zero. Thus all homology maps are isomorphisms. Plus.isIso_iff makes the canonical derived exchange invertible.

Map this isomorphism along the fully faithful Plus inclusion. Compose the two bounded-below/total right-derived compatibility isomorphisms and the exact inverse-image single-functor isomorphism. This gives the displayed total-derived objects without changing F or any map.

theorem nonempty_limit_derivedDirectImage_single_iso
    {k : Type u} [Field k]
    {I : Type u} [SmallCategory I] [IsCofiltered I]
    (D : I ⥤ Over (Spec (.of k)))
    [∀ i, QuasiCompact (D.obj i).hom] [∀ i, QuasiSeparated (D.obj i).hom]
    [∀ {i j : I} (a : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map a).left]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit ((Over.forget _).mapCone c))
    [QuasiCompact c.pt.hom] [QuasiSeparated c.pt.hom]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (hstage : ∀ i, IsIso
      ((derivedBaseChangeMapPlus AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        (IsPullback.of_hasPullback f (D.obj i).hom).toCommSq).app
          ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F))) :
    Nonempty
      (((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} c.pt.hom).mapDerivedCategory).obj
          ((lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
            ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F)) ≅
        (lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (pullback.snd f c.pt.hom)).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
            ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (pullback.fst f c.pt.hom)).obj F)))
